The Owls, led by second-year head coach [[Aaron McKie]], play their home games at the [[Liacouras Center]] in [[Philadelphia]] as a member of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 5–11 and 4–10 in [[2020–21 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC Play]], and finished in 9th place. They lost in the first round of the [[2021 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] to [[2020–21 South Florida Bulls men's basketball team|South Florida]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Temple Owls men's basketball team|Owls]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 14–17, 6–12 in [[2019–20 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in tenth place.
